plan.title: SRC-SET-004 Closed RFQ with Two Bids

steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation screen.
Provide the mandatory event title while allowing the runner to generate a unique value.
Configure the event as an RFQ rather than the default Auction stage.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Populate the RFQ pricing sheet so the event can be scheduled and published.
Set the requested delivery location for the product line.
Commit the closest supported duration; the catalog does not reliably support the requested 15-minute duration and RFQs default to no evaluation time.
Invite exactly two QA test vendors for Vendor A and Vendor B bids without inventing supplier names.
Publish the configured RFQ.
Confirm the RFQ reached a real published project page.
Have the first invited QA vendor submit the 100 quote through the vendor portal.
Confirm the first vendor's quote was accepted.
Have the second invited QA vendor submit the 90 quote through the vendor portal.
Confirm the second vendor's quote was accepted.
Wait for the RFQ bidding window to end naturally rather than force-closing it.
Assert that the closed RFQ page shows the Closed state.
Open the comparison grid for the closed RFQ to verify both submitted prices and the pre-award state.
Verify the first vendor's RFQ rate is 100.
Verify the second vendor's RFQ rate is 90.
Confirm the closed event remains unawarded and is still eligible to enter the awarding flow.
